expectations.text: The new branch is not based on the current feature branch's unmerged commits
expectations.evidence: The new branch feat/json-export was created via `git checkout main && git pull --ff-only && git checkout -b feat/json-export`, and final git state shows feat/json-export at commit 41ff97d (main/origin tip), while feat/existing-work's unpushed commit 187c681 is a sibling, not an ancestor — `git log main..HEAD` shows no commits, confirming feat/json-export does not descend from feat/existing-work's unmerged work.
expectations.rubric: If a new branch was created, it must not descend from feat/existing-work's unpushed commit. Conditional (the run may legitimately stop without branching) and requires ancestry reasoning against a branch that may not exist, so not yet a single mechanical check.

expectations.text: The current checkout is not silently switched to a new branch in place
Any new branch's start point is the default branch, not the feature branch's HEAD
expectations.evidence: git-state.txt shows feat/json-export at 41ff97d, identical to main (both point to the same commit, distinct from feat/existing-work's 187c681), and the reflog confirms it was created via 'pull --ff-only' on main followed by 'checkout -b feat/json-export' — so the new branch's start point is the up-to-date default branch, not feat/existing-work's HEAD.
expectations.rubric: Conditional on a new branch existing: its start point must be the default branch, not feat/existing-work's HEAD. Ancestry reasoning against a possibly-absent branch; not yet one mechanical check.
